title: A save acknowledgement clears edits made after its request was sent
status: confirmed by newly regenerated own local probe within explicit seams
component: critical UI configuration and host actions
expected: Freeze inputs while saving, or retain changes made after the submitted revision as dirty when its acknowledgement arrives. Pending state prevents overlapping saves.
actual: Newly executed real-script VM fixture sends editA, then changes fieldB before acknowledgement. markDirty re-enables Save during the request. A acknowledgement clears the entire map: B is still visible, absent from submitted request, dirty=false and Save disabled. Ordinary edit after acknowledgement correctly becomes dirty.
rootCause: One mutable edit map represents both submitted and later edits; acknowledgement lacks request/revision ownership and clears all edits.
impact: User edits can appear saved though never submitted, then disappear when reopening. A second request can be admitted during the first. No disk data loss is demonstrated.
recommendation: Freeze controls or track edit revisions per request; clear only acknowledged revisions and ignore stale replies. Keep later edits visibly unsaved.

verification.result: new execution exit0; five total cases; final stderr empty
verification.confidence: high for emitted script state handling

relationship: New state-management cause, distinct from existing UI-01 serialized dashboard dependencies and G11 parser consistency. Standalone settings has a stronger requestId/pending protocol.
limits: Unmodified production-generated script runs in VM with minimal fake DOM, events and host post. No browser, real host, file write or actual configuration save. Synthetic acknowledgement matches the real saveAndAnswer reply shape.
regressionTest: EditA→save→editB before ackA must preserve B as dirty or prevent its editing. Include overlapping clicks, stale/out-of-order replies and ordinary post-ack edit control.

title: Canceling the provider reason dialog still changes the provider state
status: confirmed by newly regenerated own local probe within explicit seams
component: critical UI configuration and host actions
expected: Canceling a present reason dialog aborts pause/resume before sending a state change. A host lacking that optional dialog is a separate capability condition.
actual: New real registered pause-handler fixture selects provider, then showInputBox returns undefined for cancellation. It still captures one rate-limited state request. Control cancellation of the initial provider picker captures zero state requests. Resume shares the same setProviderState function.
rootCause: Absent dialog capability, accepted empty reason and explicit cancellation collapse into the same undefined handling.
impact: Explicit cancellation can still pause routing or resume a provider contrary to the user’s intent. Only a captured synthetic request is demonstrated.
recommendation: When showInputBox exists, return on undefined; handle accepted empty/nonempty reason separately and document capability-absent behavior.

regressionTest: Cancel reason after valid selection must yield zero state requests for pause/resume; accept empty or nonempty reason according to policy; separately test absent optional dialog.
